weekend-german-classes-online: Klarweg has no weekend batch listed yet. Its 20-minute ₹100 teacher demos run on Friday and Sunday from 4:20 p.m. IST when slots are open, one-to-one lessons are scheduled with the teacher, and the self-paced course works on any day.
one-to-one-german-classes-online: Klarweg lists one-to-one German at A1–B2 for ₹22,000 per level, or ₹15,000 with code PERSONAL7000, scheduled directly with the teacher. No course has dates yet, so payments are not open; a 20-minute ₹100 demo can be booked when slots are shown. Ask how many lessons a course includes before paying.
german-classes-for-working-professionals: If your work hours are predictable, reserve a fixed study block and compare available live options. If your roster changes, start with self-paced German and add a teacher session when you can commit to a time. Klarweg has self-paced A1–C2 and teacher-led options at A1–B2.
how-long-to-learn-german-a1: An illustrative 60-hour study plan takes 6 weeks at 10 hours a week, 10 weeks at 6 hours, or 15 weeks at 4 hours. Your calendar depends on what you already know, how much you practise and how independently you can use all four skills.
a1-to-b2-german-course-duration: An illustrative A1-to-B2 budget of 460 study hours takes about 58 study weeks at eight hours weekly or 39 at twelve. These are planning examples. Schedule exam dates, holidays and feedback separately.
german-sentences-for-beginners: Start with four lines you can change today: Ich heiße Asha. Ich wohne in Pune. Ich spreche Hindi. Ich lerne Deutsch. The table below gives 12 phrases with English meanings and Hindi cues.
german-conversation-practice-online: You can practise German conversation here with three ready-to-use A1–B1 role-plays, model lines and a feedback check. Use them with a partner on a call or record both sides yourself.
goethe-a1-mock-test: Take this free 35-minute Goethe A1 mini mock: six listening tasks with audio and six reading tasks you can check on this page, plus a form, a 30-word message and all three speaking parts with model answers. It is original Klarweg practice with fewer tasks than the real exam, so it shows your weakest skill but not an official score.
german-learning-app-for-beginners: For a beginner, look for German audio, explanations you understand, exercises that make you recall words and feedback you can act on. You can test Klarweg’s browser-based course with the free first chapter before choosing a paid plan.
free-german-course-online: Klarweg gives you the first chapter of every level from A1 to C2 free, plus 400 practice pages with explained answers, 38 grammar guides, three printable PDFs and a Goethe A1 mini mock. Beginners should start with A1 Chapter 1 and follow the free first-week plan below. Later chapters are paid, from ₹1,999 for A1.
oesd-a1-exam-preparation: ÖSD A1 has a written module covering reading, listening and writing and an oral module covering speaking. Use the drills on this page to practise each skill, then use ÖSD’s official material when you want to rehearse its exact format.
testdaf-preparation-course-checklist: A TestDaF prep course should match your exam format, give you academic reading and listening tasks, and provide detailed feedback on writing and recorded speaking. Klarweg offers general German study, so ask a TestDaF provider specifically about exam training.
dsh-exam-preparation: Prepare for the DSH with your target institution’s published rules and samples. Practise turning a source into a short summary and separating its findings from your interpretation. The exercise on this page gives you a starting point.
b2-german-for-nurses: This page gives you a B2-level German handover drill for reporting confirmed details, flagging missing information and assigning a follow-up. Check the relevant authority for recognition, language evidence and any profession-specific exam expectations.
german-for-doctors: Practise the German for clarifying a patient’s timeline and reporting it to a colleague. This page has both versions of the exchange. It is language practice. Check the responsible authority for recognition and any required professional language exam.
german-for-engineering-students: Start with the German for reading measurements, naming deviations and assigning the next lab task. This page gives a measurement scenario, a model response and a second reading to try.
german-for-mba-students: Practise German for MBA cases by stating your recommendation, naming the assumption it depends on and proposing a test. This page provides a fictional case, model response and way to challenge the decision.
german-language-for-jobs-in-germany: The German you need for a job depends on the role and employer. Read the advert for the exact wording, then ask which tasks depend on German and what proof is expected. This page gives sample phrases and an interview drill.
intensive-german-courses-india: Compare the total weekly workload, not just the advertised finish date. Two sample schedules below require 10 or 11 hours weekly including homework. Klarweg lists live teacher options at A1–B2; confirm any intensive timetable directly before committing.
online-german-course-certificate-fees: A recognised German certificate usually comes from a separate exam, not from the course. Klarweg does not issue certificates. Its self-paced A1 course costs ₹1,999, and the Goethe A1 exam costs ₹10,000 for dates from January 2027, so A1 course plus certificate totals ₹11,999. B1 totals ₹23,999.
online-german-a1-classes: You can start Klarweg’s self-paced A1 course today: Chapter 1 is free and full A1 costs ₹1,999. Live A1 classes with a teacher are listed at ₹16,000 for a group or ₹22,000 one-to-one before coupons. No batch dates are announced yet, but you can book a 20-minute ₹100 demo when slots are open.
online-german-b1-classes: You can start Klarweg’s self-paced B1 today: Chapter 1 is free and the full 35-chapter course costs ₹3,999 for two years. Live B1 classes are listed at ₹16,000 (group) or ₹22,000 (one-to-one) before coupons, but no batch is open yet. Six quick questions below show whether you are ready for B1.
german-course-fees-in-hindi: Klarweg पर हर स्तर का पहला अध्याय मुफ़्त है। सेल्फ-पेस्ड A1 ₹1,999 और Lifetime A1–C2 ₹4,999 है। लाइव ग्रुप कोर्स ₹16,000 (कूपन के साथ ₹13,000) प्रति स्तर है, पर अभी बैच घोषित नहीं हैं। Goethe A1 परीक्षा की फीस जनवरी 2027 से ₹10,000 है और अलग से देनी होती है।
german-a1-30-day-study-plan: Use the next 30 days to build an A1 foundation. Practise sounds, questions, times and simple plans. Each week ends with something you can do without notes. Completing this plan does not by itself establish A1 readiness.
german-a1-syllabus-checklist: German A1 covers basic everyday communication: hear names and times, read short notices, write simple messages and take part in brief exchanges. Try one task for each skill below and check the sample answers.
german-a1-worksheet-hindi: Download a free three-page German A1 worksheet PDF or use it on this page: 20 exercises on introductions, sein and haben, articles with kein, and times and days. Each task has a Hindi cue, and the answer key explains why each answer is correct.
german-a1-listening-practice: Do six short A1 listening exercises on this page: appointments, platforms, prices, phone numbers, dates and weather. Press Play, choose an answer and check it instantly with an explanation. Audio uses a German voice on your device; every transcript is included if your device has none.
goethe-b1-exam-preparation-plan: Goethe B1 has four modules, each marked out of 100 and passed separately with 60 points. In the last four weeks: diagnose with an official practice set, train your weakest task types, practise speaking and writing to time, then rehearse the full exam. Fees from January 2027: ₹20,000, or ₹5,000 per module.
b1-german-ausbildung-interview: Practise three German apprenticeship interview questions about motivation, teamwork and what you do when instructions are unclear. Use the models to shape truthful answers for your own trade.
a1-speaking-practice-family-reunion: Goethe A1 speaking Teil 1 ends with spelling a word and saying a number, and the same skills come up on the phone and at appointments in Germany. Learn the eight German letter names Indian learners mix up, check yourself with eight questions, then practise four turns with a partner.
online-german-a2-classes: Start A2 if you can introduce yourself, ask basic questions and understand simple times and places. Klarweg offers self-paced A2 and lists A2 teachers. Check each teacher’s available times before planning a course.
online-german-b2-classes: B2 practice suits learners who can already explain an opinion and understand the main point of familiar texts. Choose self-paced study for flexible progression or check live B2 options if you need regular feedback on extended answers.
german-tutor-online-india: Before paying a German tutor, check six things: levels and exam experience, Hindi or English support, how much you speak in the trial, how they correct you, a fixed IST slot, and the total fee per level. Klarweg offers a 20-minute ₹100 demo with a verified A1–B2 teacher; course batches are not open yet.
learn-german-online-india: Choose your route by goal. A spouse visa usually needs an A1 exam, Ausbildung often B1–B2, and university study often TestDaF or DSH. On Klarweg you can start free with Chapter 1 at any level, take self-paced A1 for ₹1,999 or Lifetime A1–C2 for ₹4,999, and add a ₹100 teacher demo for speaking feedback. Exam fees are paid separately.
german-a2-mini-practice-test: Try one short task per skill to spot what needs more A2 practice. This mini test is original Klarweg practice. For the full timing and scoring of your chosen exam, use its official materials.
german-b2-mini-practice-test: This original mini test practises careful B2 reading and building an argument from evidence. Use it to check how well you can separate a finding, an objection and a recommendation.
german-a2-writing-practice-online: A useful A2 rescheduling message says which appointment needs to change, why, and what alternative you propose. Try the task below before revealing the model.
german-b2-speaking-practice-online: Practise B2 speaking by explaining a choice, acknowledging a trade-off and answering a follow-up. Use this drill with a partner or record a response and answer your own follow-up question.
german-language-basics-for-beginners: Start with three building blocks: a simple statement, a noun with its article and one polite question. Say each example out loud, then change one detail without looking at the answer.
german-a2-course-fees: Klarweg’s self-paced A2 course costs ₹2,999 one-time for two years, and Lifetime A1–C2 costs ₹4,999. Live A2 classes are listed at ₹16,000 (group) or ₹22,000 (one-to-one) before coupons, but no batches are open yet. The Goethe A2 exam is separate: ₹12,000 for dates from January 2027.
german-a2-listening-practice: At A2, listen for a correction after words such as doch, statt and ab. Try the three short messages on this page and identify what actually applies. Playback uses a German voice on your device when available.
german-b2-listening-practice: For B2 listening, track who says what and whether they are proposing, objecting or deciding. This original exercise separates a suggested policy, a concern and the final decision.
goethe-b1-speaking-partner-topics: Practise three B1 discussion topics with a partner: a study session, a neighbourhood event and a trip. Each partner should make a suggestion, respond to a constraint and confirm the decision. These cards are original practice.
goethe-a1-reading-practice-notices: A1 reading often comes down to locating a useful detail: when to arrive, where to go or what to bring. Read the notices below and answer from the written information.
telc-b2-writing-practice: A useful B2 complaint identifies what was promised, what went wrong and what you want the recipient to do. Try the original task below. Check official telc materials for the current exam instructions and timing.
german-for-healthcare-reception: At reception, practise checking a name, confirming the appointment time and giving one clear instruction. Use fictional information for these language drills.
german-for-university-seminars: For German-language seminars, practise summarising a source, qualifying a claim and asking a clear follow-up. Use the exercise below to rehearse those moves. Confirm any language proof directly with your programme.
german-ausbildung-weekly-study-plan: Build your weekly German practice around an apprenticeship listing you genuinely want to apply to. Identify its main tasks and stated language requirement, then practise one of those tasks in German. Requirements vary by listing.
german-questions-for-beginners-hindi: German में सवाल बनाने के लिए Wo, Wann और Wie से शुरू करें। उसके बाद क्रिया रखें। नीचे छोटे उदाहरण और हिंदी संकेत हैं, फिर खुद तीन सवाल बनाकर जवाब जाँचें।
german-pronunciation-ch-ich-ach: In standard German, the ch in ich is usually a more forward sound than the ch in ach. Use the pairs below to notice the difference, then practise in short phrases.
german-a1-word-order-in-hindi: साधारण German statement में conjugated verb दूसरे स्थान पर आता है। पहला हिस्सा बदलने पर subject की जगह बदल सकती है। नीचे तीन patterns देखकर अपने वाक्य बनाइए।
german-alphabet-spelling-names: Practise German letter names by spelling a name and asking someone to read it back. Focus on common confusions such as J versus Y, and V versus W.
goethe-a1-speaking-requests: Practise making a clear A1 request, then respond as the listener. Say what you need, use bitte where it fits and listen for whether the other person can help.
german-a2-speaking-questions: A useful A2 conversation grows from the answer you just heard. Ask one follow-up about the time, place, person or reason instead of moving straight to another topic.
german-b1-listening-key-details: In B1 listening, the first detail can be the normal rule. Listen for who the exception affects and what applies today. Try the two short announcements before opening their transcripts.
goethe-b1-writing-revision: A strong B1 email tells the reader what happened, why it matters and what response you want. Revise the example on this page before checking the model.
telc-b2-speaking-discussion-practice: In this original telc B2 preparation drill, give a position with a reason, respond to a partner’s objection and suggest a workable next step. Use the official materials for the current exam format.
german-b2-source-paraphrase-practice: A sound B2 paraphrase keeps facts, time limits and uncertainty from the original. Change the wording while preserving what the source actually says.
german-b1-workplace-speaking-practice: Use B1 German at work to say what changed, what you will do next and when another person should expect an update. Try a short stand-up message below.
german-a1-grammar-mistakes-hindi: A1 grammar सुधारने के लिए पहले तीन बातें जाँचें। Subject के साथ सही verb ending, घड़ी के समय के साथ um और noun के साथ उसका article। नीचे तीन गलत वाक्य ठीक करके देखें।
